name: Thompson Palm Springs

address.street: 414 N Palm Canyon Drive Palm Springs

insider_take: Desert modernism meets poolside glamour at this stylish retreat where mid-century architecture and mountain views create the perfect Palm Springs vibe.
whats_special: Thompson Palm Springs sits in the heart of the Uptown Design District, featuring a stunning rooftop pool with 360-degree views of the San Jacinto Mountains. The hotel's design pays homage to Palm Springs' iconic mid-century modern architecture while offering contemporary luxury amenities and locally-inspired dining.
pro_tip: Book a sunset cocktail at the rooftop bar during golden hour - the mountain views are absolutely spectacular and it's the perfect spot for those Instagram-worthy desert shots.
dont_miss: The weekly poolside DJ sets that capture the essence of Palm Springs' party scene, and take a short walk to explore the Uptown Design District's galleries, vintage shops, and the famous Palm Springs Air Museum just minutes away.
pros: Modern desert-chic design with stylish contemporary furnishings
Prime downtown Palm Springs location within walking distance to shops and restaurants
Beautiful rooftop pool deck with mountain views and cabanas
Pet-friendly accommodations with special amenities for furry guests
cons: Limited on-site dining options compared to larger resort properties
Boutique hotel size means fewer amenities than full-service resorts
